subject.title: Org claim: vmware-aiops + vmware-monitor — @kingaiwork lookalikes impersonate @zw008 listings (same pattern as #2966/#3035)

question: Should staff hard-delete the two verified `@kingaiwork` VMware skill records and separately review the publisher account for repeated impersonation enforcement?
rationale: Only authorized staff can validate production ownership, preserve necessary moderation evidence, approve destructive deletion, and determine account-level enforcement.

options.title: Verify and hard-delete
options.body: Preserve the necessary audit evidence, delete only the two disputed record IDs, verify both established releases list successfully, and conduct a separate account review.

options.title: Reconcile without deletion
options.body: Use a staff-approved data repair or reassignment only if it can remove slug ambiguity without attaching lookalike versions or statistics to the established listings.

options.title: Keep records hidden
options.body: Leave the records retained and instead change all scan and publish lookups to tolerate duplicate slugs, accepting ongoing orphaned data and broader implementation work.

recommendation.title: Verify and hard-delete
recommendation.body: Preserve the necessary audit evidence, delete only the two disputed record IDs, verify both established releases list successfully, and conduct a separate account review.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant current-main hard-delete, skill ownership, and scan history is concentrated in their commits to `convex/skills.ts`.
